command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "foreach (`$device in @('Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','PE1','PE3','SZ_AR')) { if (`$device -match '^Core') { `$wanted='GigabitEthernet1/0/(4|8|9)' } elseif (`$device -match '^FW') { `$wanted='GigabitEthernet1/0/(1|2|3)' } elseif (`$device -eq 'PE1') { `$wanted='Ethernet(1/0/2|2/0/0)' } else { `$wanted='Ethernet1/0/(0|1)' }; `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/' + `$device + '/command?cmd=display%20interface'); `$capture=0; foreach (`$line in (`$r.output -split '\r?\n')) { if (`$line -match ('^' + `$wanted + ' current state')) { Write-Output ('DEVICE=' + `$device); `$capture=32 } elseif (`$line -match '^[A-Za-z].* current state') { `$capture=0 }; if (`$capture -gt 0) { Write-Output `$line; `$capture-- } } }"
